>
[Scarred Hide](/Feats.aspx?ID=5512) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 79

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486)

</column>

---

Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts. When in your hybrid or animal shape, you gain resistance to non-[silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2920) slashing damage equal to half your level.
